subject: history
concept: Building a simple personal timeline of your own life so far
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student arranges picture cards of life stages (baby, toddler, now) in order along a simple timeline
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a life-stage picture to roughly where it belongs on a timeline
exercise.abstract: Student describes one thing about themselves at an earlier point compared to now

misconception_flags: places life stages out of chronological order

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
